Printable Shortwave Schedule Cards

Print a pocket schedule card for any station or language, with times in UTC and your own time zone. Handy next to the radio, in a go-bag, or to hand out at a club meeting.

Tips

Times change at the season change (last Sunday of March and October), so reprint then. For a live, personal version, use My Schedule. For an emergency card, see the emergency shortwave guide.
